Sr Product & Business Mgr, XR Devices

Dolby · San Francisco, CA · Senior


ROLE SUMMARY

Define and drive the future of immersive and interactive entertainment across Smart/AI Glasses, audio wearables (true wireless earbuds/headphones), and head-mounted displays (XR devices). End-to-end ownership of a portfolio that enables Dolby XR audio and video experiences for consumers, with revenue accountability.

Team / product: Cross-functional product + business owner for Dolby XR audio and video experiences across Smart/AI Glasses, true wireless audio wearables, and head-mounted displays. Sits at the seam between Dolby's Entertainment Business Group and the Advanced Technology Group.


QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of progressive product management experience leading audio and/or video product strategies for consumer electronics devices, ideally including Smart Glasses, HMDs, or audio wearables.
- Strong understanding of multimedia systems and AV SoC architectures, mobile displays, and camera technologies.
- Experience collaborating with major consumer electronics SoC suppliers (Qualcomm, MediaTek, Airoha, BES).
- Experience with embedded software, SDKs, and audio/video technologies.
- Audio: spatial audio. Video: HDR and 3D technologies.
- Proven ability to build and scale ecosystems enabling multiple partners.
- Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; advanced degree preferred.


RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the product lifecycle for a portfolio of XR and wearable device experiences (vision, roadmap, PMF validation, execution).
- Lead cross-functional collaboration across Dolby teams to deliver a cohesive XR ecosystem.
- Bridge the Entertainment Business Group and the Advanced Technology Group; partner with research to translate innovation into scalable offerings.
- Act as a SME on XR audio and video tech for immersive content capture and playback (e.g., 360 degree and 6DoF).
- Develop and communicate business strategy; build alignment across the org.
- Partner with Marketing to shape and execute go-to-market strategies.
- Own revenue planning and execution for the XR and wearables device portfolio.
